common_observation.declared_scope_representation: The frozen contract uses scope as either one canonical output ID or a slash-delimited set of canonical output IDs.
common_observation.runtime_representation: The executable result and persisted topology expose each output under its own canonical output ID.
common_observation.current_resolver: semantic.py performs a direct meshes.get(scope), then falls back to the only loaded mesh even when an explicit scope is not found.
common_observation.incorrect_behavior: A slash-delimited scope cannot resolve to separate output meshes; an invalid explicit scope can also be silently redirected to a sole mesh.

subclusters.root_cause: The explicit multi-output scope is treated as one dictionary key instead of being resolved against the separate canonical runtime output IDs.
subclusters.evidence: Frozen scopes, reconciled output IDs, and semantic.py scope lookup agree; no source or geometry change is needed to establish the mismatch.
